title: Axon v3.2.0 - Format-Agnostic Model Installation
summary: Axon v3.2.0 introduces format-agnostic model installation with the new --format flag, case-insensitive model lookup, YOLO support, and multi-encoder ONNX conversion for CLIP and T5 models.
highlights: New --format flag for controlling execution format (onnx, pytorch, tensorflow, auto)
Case-insensitive model lookup and YOLO model support
Multi-encoder ONNX support for CLIP, T5, and complex architectures
Format-agnostic installation - use models in their native format
Universal ONNX conversion with repository-specific strategies
